title: CTFS : Collaborative Teacher Framework for Forward-Looking Sonar Image Semantic Segmentation with Extremely Limited Labels
abstract: arXiv:2603.21071v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As one of the most important underwater sensing technologies, forward-looking sonar exhibits unique imaging characteristics. Sonar images are often affected by severe speckle noise, low texture contrast, acoustic shadows, and geometric distortions. These factors make it difficult for traditional teacher-student frameworks to achieve satisfactory performance in sonar semantic segmentation tasks under extremely limited labeled data conditions. To address this issue, we propose a Collaborative Teacher Semantic Segmentation Framework for forward-looking sonar images. This framework introduces a multi-teacher collaborative mechanism composed of one general teacher and multiple sonar-specific teachers. translated_title: CTFS：面向极有限标注条件下前视声呐图像语义分割的协作教师框架
translated_abstract: 作为最重要的水下感知技术之一，前视声呐具有独特的成像特性。声呐图像通常受到严重散斑噪声、低纹理对比度、声学阴影和几何畸变的影响。这些因素使得传统的师生框架在极有限标注数据条件下难以在声呐语义分割任务中取得令人满意的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向前视声呐图像的协作教师语义分割框架。该框架引入了一种由一个通用教师和多个声呐专用教师组成的多教师协作机制。通过采用多教师交替引导策略，学生模型能够在学习通用语义表征的同时捕捉声呐图像的独特特性，从而实现更全面和（更精准的分割性能）。
tldr: 提出了一种由一个通用教师和多个声呐专用教师组成的多教师协作框架CTFS，通过多教师交替引导策略，在极有限标注条件下显著提升了前视声呐图像语义分割的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes CTFS, a collaborative multi-teacher framework composed of one general teacher and multiple sonar-specific teachers, which significantly improves forward-looking sonar image semantic segmentation under extremely limited labels through a multi-teacher alternating guidance strategy.
